is_anopheles.evidence: Studies Anopheles arabiensis and Anopheles gambiae s.s. (Kisumu strain) (p. 3).

reports_target_markers.evidence: Mentions that the Kisumu lab strain lacks kdr L1014S/F and Ace-1 G119S, but does not perform genotyping of target markers in this study (p. 3).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: No extractable genotype counts, allele counts, or genotype frequencies are reported.

african_field_population.evidence: Wild Anopheles arabiensis larvae were collected in Lower Moshi, Tanzania and tested as F0 adults (p. 3).

is_primary_study.evidence: Primary empirical study evaluating experimental hut modifications in Moshi, Tanzania (p. 3).

sub_country_location.evidence: Pasua field station, Lower Moshi, Tanzania (03°22.764′ S, 37°20.793 E) (p. 3).

duplicate_risk.evidence: Primary study reporting original experimental hut trial data.

supplement.evidence: No supplementary material needed as no genotype data were collected.

assessment.summary: This study evaluates modifications to East African style experimental huts (baffle exit hole size and exterior wall sticky traps) in Moshi, Tanzania using field-collected F0 Anopheles arabiensis and laboratory Anopheles gambiae Kisumu. The study does not perform or report genotyping of target insecticide resistance markers and is therefore ineligible.
exclusion_reasons: Does not genotype target insecticide resistance markers in field mosquito populations.
Does not report extractable genotype data or allele frequencies.
